source: P3-01 original 4 steps and 17 Q, frozen features/modules/types.ts and actual DefinitionCycle Host consumer contract
test_boundary: Real moduleAuthoring.ts and existing projectHost.ts SDK with actual Tauri API invoke entry replaced only by recorded deterministic protocol fixtures; no process, Host, Engine, listener or real picker is launched
fixed_expectations: ImportPackage/ExportPackage choose actual native file-selection command; SaveProject/ExportEvaluation use native directory-selection command; typed Cancelled returns null, other errors propagate
DefinitionTask observation keeps actual ProjectId, original opaque DraftId, exact Draft revision, TaskId and original TaskOutput/TaskState
Sample readiness requires exact Draft Scope in describe_capabilities, never operation-only authorized flag or another Draft
Each actual sample request freshly checks capabilities and uses input_revision=DraftR, definition_revision=DraftR, unmodified explicit ScenarioInput and its ProjectR
Original Host RevisionConflict/PermissionDenied/other API errors are not converted into success or a manufactured Task
Actual failed/cancelled terminal TaskState is returned unchanged to the sample panel; incomplete/missing terminal does not imply completion
Session/project switch before or during a request/picker/task prevents publishing old-context results, without invoking cancel or rewriting Scope
Foreign/mismatched Task identity or scope/revision is rejected
Five non-simulation categories and two deferred TaskKind scopes remain unavailable when Host does not advertise them
Template composition remains explicitly unavailable until real carrier is frozen; no invented public operation/type/field
frozen_template_carrier_expectations: Only actual available_command_kinds=put_template_composition enables save; recheck actual capability before mutation
Existing Draft saves one put_template_composition Command using base_revision=DraftR and payload.project_revision=captured ProjectR, then reads actual Host Definition/path and actual commit history
New definition uses existing create_definition_draft followed by atomic composition save; they are two calls, not one atomic create
Second call failure after successful creation carries only real createdDraft/creationCommit and original cause, leaves local definition/subset intact, and retry may explicitly use that Draft
Existing Draft revision conflict propagates original HostFailure without claiming a new Draft or changing input
Draft TemplatePreview uses exact DefinitionDraft Scope/ModuleRef and source.base_revision=DraftR; returned preview.base_revision remains actual ProjectR with no inferred paths, seeds or instances
frozen_seed_context_reference_expectatio: Forward the explicitly captured source_scenario id/revision unchanged with the complete declared subset.seed; no automatic current Scenario lookup/rebase
Absent source_scenario stays absent even if Workspace contains a current Scenario; explicit null remains explicit null
Source Scenario/Project conflict returns original HostFailure and captured input unchanged; partial creation failure keeps cause/created Draft and does not rewrite the captured source
Actual returned TemplatePreview including its exact old source_scenario is returned unchanged; missing ref is never inferred from seed body or current Workspace
Original sixteen checks remain unchanged; no new process, Host, Engine, Native UI or seed adoption is claimed by these wire fixtures
